opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £56,000 year 1, £28,000 years 2‑3, plus up to £6,000 per annum research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in a UK university, must hold a doctorate and have submitted their thesis for viva by the closing date.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research at a UK university.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and eligible UK independent research institutes; applicants must be employed by the institution and lead the project.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative original research projects of up to five years, covering staff costs and associated research expenses.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding medical/clinical, policy‑driven, immediate commercial, database‑focused, advocacy)

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university staff (or specialist arts institutions) must coordinate the visit; the host institution must administer the grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK institutions to invite eminent overseas professors for 3–12 month visits to enhance skills and knowledge in under‑represented research areas.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary contribution up to £56,000 year 1, £28,000 years 2‑3; research expenses up to £6,000 per annum

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in humanities or social sciences employed by a UK university; no need to be at professorial level.
opportunities.summary: Provides salary support for 2–3 year fellowships to enable distinguished researchers to complete original research.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: Up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with at least two years post‑PhD experience, holding a permanent UK university appointment (or nominated) and not previously leading a research team.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build and lead a modest research team to tackle a distinctive research problem.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding medical/clinical, policy‑driven, immediate commercial, database‑focused, advocacy)

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering fine and performing arts training for school‑age children (under 18).
opportunities.summary: Funds arts training programmes (e.g., weekend, after‑school, holiday) for outstanding students without financial means.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship – Undergraduate & Postgraduate

amount.raw: Maximum total award £475,000; bursaries £5,000‑£10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities offering undergraduate or postgraduate fine and performing arts programmes.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries to support outstanding undergraduate and postgraduate arts students in financial need.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired senior researchers living in the UK, who have held a teaching/research post at a UK university (or eligible independent research institute).
opportunities.summary: Supports retired scholars to complete a research project and prepare results for publication.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Up to £5 million total (ten awards); funds up to 18 four‑year doctoral scholarships per award

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers (or consortia of up to two universities).
opportunities.summary: Provides doctoral scholarships (including for under‑represented groups and international students) and related programme support over a nine‑year period.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding medical/clinical, policy‑driven, immediate commercial, database‑focused, advocacy)

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (including Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial) with research degree awarding powers; single or multi‑institution centres encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Funds large‑scale, interdisciplinary research centres aiming for transformative, blue‑sky research over up to ten years.
